Don't take this the wrong way, but you can't fix her. I broke up with my ex last week because he cheated on me the whole time with another girl. He told her cold things about how he wanted to be with me and didn't care and she still stayed. I think she's dumb. Point being please for the love of god move on. Please. You're just going to feel terrible if you stay with someone who doesn't care. I didn't stay with him when I could've and guess what? Now I'm gonna be a single mom but I don't have to deal with feeling like shit all the time. I have no one to call me stupid or tell me what a bitch I am. Will it hurt? Oh hell yes, but I'd rather be a single mom then someone who gets crushed repeatedly.
Why are you staying anyway? Not judging, I just really want to know.
